prompt: A realistic 1920s photograph on grainy colour film: real people with real skin, pores and stubble. A double exposure: inside the silhouette of the bank clerk there is a second image of the bank vault, gangsters filling sacks, in burning amber and red, while the face nearest the camera stays realistic and readable. Camera from inside a round steel vault door looking out at a marble bank lobby, the door's bolts and hinge framing the shot. At a loan desk, a worker in his only suit sits before a thin clerk with round spectacles and a pen hovering; behind them, gangsters in pinstripes walk straight past a dozing guard towards the camera with empty sacks. Light: tall windows throwing hard daylight slats across the marble; brass desk lamps; the polished floor holding every light. Plain margins with no writing. Thanks.
